existing.description: The Stamps Scholarship is the University of Miami's most prestigious merit award, given to exceptional and academically accomplished high school seniors who apply and are admitted through Early Decision I or Early Action. Stamps Scholars receive the full cost of attendance for up to eight semesters (ten for five-year programs) or until completion of their first degree, whichever comes first. The package covers tuition and fees, on-campus housing, a meal plan, University health insurance, textbooks and a laptop allowance, plus access to a $12,000 enrichment fund. There is no separate scholarship application beyond the Common Application, semi-finalists are interviewed by mid-January, and recipients are announced in early March.
eligibility: All incoming first-year students applying to University of Miami (domestic and international).
